$comment: CLOSED, committed exemption list for scripts/lang-gate.mjs (ADR-M004 D7, Lot X). GENERATED from the frozen sources (schemas/*.json descriptions, schemas/forbidden-keys.json, packages/contracts/src/enums.ts) so the strings are byte-exact; the output is committed and static. terms=whole-token exempt (frozen contract identifiers, FORBIDDEN_KEYS, COVERAGE_REASONS, Shogen fixture keys, proper nouns). phrases=exact-substring exempt (governance corpus name, CI job names, and the 5 FROZEN JSON-Schema descriptions — ADR-M001, byte-frozen by contracts-frozen.test.ts, forbidden to modify in Lot X; re-issuing them in English is an ADR decision, formed pending in docs/G1-lot-X.md). patterns=regex refs (ADR-M00x, R-xx, §, harness_version). Removing a frozen identifier here reddens the gate on that token (test 42 mutant) — the exemption is load-bearing. ADR-M004 D7 quater (2026-09-07): frozen TEST-NAME identifiers defined in ADR-M002 that collide with an fr-word are also exempt terms — 'fictitious_default_le_n_rounds' (Lot U test #19) and 'interval_lo_le_hi' (hikae test #15), where the substring '_le_' is the abbreviation for the math relation ≤, not the French article; the Lot-X generator only covered schema/enum sources, never ADR-defined test names.
phrases: Invariant de flotte MONARK (ADR-M001 Decision 7). Union citee de DEUX disciplines de source primaire : Shogen 03 §0 (temoignage_canonique.rs L15-19 : pas de champ verite, pas de score de confiance, pas de 'validated') + Grok hac-cp.ts:77 (p_correct, confidence, hallucination_score, hallucination). AUCUNE de ces cles ne doit apparaitre a AUCUN niveau d'un contrat serialise. Enforcement primaire = schemas fermes (additionalProperties:false) ; cette liste = defense en profondeur, appliquee RECURSIVEMENT.

Decision de gate L3 (consommee par UKEMI + le middleware Hermes). intent est string|number|null (l'union set|interval ne fuit PAS, C6) : le predicat de containment est 'intent in labels' (set) ou 'lo <= intent <= hi' (interval). remaining_budget = B_t (capacite d'autorisation conforme restante), attribut de MONARK, depletable, JAMAIS un rendement (ADR-CERT-MONARK). ADR-M001 Decision 5.

Projection d'un temoignage Shogen VERIFIE (emis uniquement apres Ok(Verdict)). Aucun champ verite/confiance/validated (Shogen 03 §0). Le nombre prix n'est PAS porte ici (trou 'sens emis', ADR-0015 pt 17bis) : il est interprete par un adaptateur HIKAE. ADR-M001 Decision 3.

Verdict de couverture conforme HIKAE. Region POLYMORPHE set|interval (set=classif btc-dir/pm-yesno ; interval=regression cascade-VaR UKEMI). SANS p_correct. alpha = couverture VISEE, pas une proba de correction. ADR-M001 Decision 4.
Le predicteur amont que HIKAE conforme (le 4e contrat, resout la caution advisor #4). Pipeline : predicteur -> Prediction -> HIKAE conforme -> CoverageVerdict -> GateDecision. ADR-M001 Decision 6.
Compliance et ingénierie logicielle et architecturale
